dedupe_keys.name: bw timex time explicit life cycle assessment

description: bw_timex is the Brightway contributor team's Python package for time-explicit life-cycle assessment. It contains routines that place supply-chain processes in time, match them to dated background inventories and tag emissions with their occurrence dates. Inputs are a Brightway model, temporal distributions and time-specific process data; outputs are time-explicit inventories suitable for dynamic impact characterisation. Geographic coverage follows the input databases. Temporal resolution and horizon follow the specified exchange timing and available inventory years, with interpolation between background datasets. BSD-3-Clause source is free through package registries and GitHub. A limitation is that the method requires credible temporal and future-process assumptions; it cannot create missing evidence about technological change. The tool supports assessments of long-lived infrastructure and evolving energy systems. Brightway (platform-brightway-lca) is the underlying platform. Separate methodology and JOSS implementation papers are cited in the repository.
name: bw_timex time-explicit life-cycle assessment
